description:
monocles translator is a translator app based on Translate You and built with Material Design 3 (You).

It supports multiple different translation engiens such as the monocles translate or other LibreTranslate instances. Also Lingva, Deepl and more.
In total, there are more than 200 supported languages across 6 different translation engines.
